1.

Heard Sri.Aravind D. Kulkarni, learned counsel appearing for petitioner, Sri.Praveena Y.
Devareddiyavara, learned High Court Government Pleader, appearing for respondent No.1-State and learned counsel Sri.D.V.Patill, appearing for respondent No.2.
2.
The parties are present before the Court along with their respective Advocates and filed a joint memo signed by them and their respective advocates.

3. Placing the joint memo on record and taking note of the fact that respondent No.2 is now married so also the appellant and further considering that the incident occurred when both were of young age and that the act was consensual in nature, this Court is of the view that the dispute and in order to put at rest the lis between the parties, which is privy to them and had no serious social impact,
following the principle of law enunciated in Ramgopal and Another vs. State of Madhya Pradesh1,
pending criminal proceedings needs to be quashed (2022) 14 SCC 531 NC: 2026:KHC-D:3187 HC-KAR especially appellant having paid sum of 3,00,000/- in cash to the second respondent as compensation.
